definitions: The outside limit of an object, area, or surface; a place or part farthest away from the centre of something.
The sharpened side of the blade of a cutting tool or weapon or of a cutting part of a device.
A point at which something may begin to happen; a verge.
examples: The edges of the paper were torn.
He sharpened the edges of his knives.
They were on the edges of a major discovery.
Her experience gave her the edges in the competition.
